_comment: Drop-in Promptfoo skeleton for the wiki-ingest PoLL pilot. See wiki/decisions/PoLL-Pilot-wiki-ingest.md for context. Per-assertion provider overrides give us a 3-juror panel. Aggregate via the named metrics in the results UI.
description: Panel-of-LLM-Judges for wiki-ingest quality grading (R-2026-002 pilot, May 2026)

options._comment: Default grader pinned to keep results reproducible across machines. Per-assertion overrides below give each juror its own model.

vars.rubric: Was the source's primary claim X faithfully extracted, with no fabrication, into the wiki page?

tests._comment: One representative test case. Replace with the 30-case hand-labeled set from the pilot fixture once available.

assert._comment: Juror 1: Claude Haiku 4.5 (Anthropic family). Inherits defaultTest grader.
Juror 3: Llama 3.3 70B Versatile via Groq (Meta-Llama family).

_protocols._comment: These describe the post-aggregation rules implemented by the pilot's result-aggregation script, NOT by Promptfoo natively. Promptfoo emits per-juror metrics; the aggregator reads results/*.json and applies these rules.
_protocols.aggregation: Simple majority of 3. Each juror returns pass/fail + score. Final verdict = majority pass/fail.
_protocols.position_swap: For pairwise rubric items, run each juror twice with swapped positions. Both runs must agree for the juror vote to count.

disagreement_protocol.2-1: Re-judge majority side with structured-action-trace template (wiki/_templates/judge-prompt-structured-trace.md). Accept re-judged majority. Log dissent for monthly review.
disagreement_protocol.abstain_1_of_3: Take majority of remaining 2; tie → human-review.
